D/ [---]TINVS PF AVG ; R/ [GLORIA] EXERC ITVS

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Reece period 17, Trier mint. Obverse description: Bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [---]TINVS PF AVG. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA] EXERC ITVS. In exergue: TPR. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this chipped coin. Diameter: 15.8mm, Weight: 1.45gms, die axis: 6
